tools.name: create_collection
tools.title: Create a collection
tools.description: Create a collection. Collections and types of the app's records. Requires memotron:write (or nucleum). Pass `idempotencyKey` to make retries safe.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters) that makes retries safe: repeating the call with the same key and arguments does not write again and returns the record's current state. A key is remembered for 24 hours; reusing it with other arguments fails with `idempotency_key_reused`.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page, with the same `sort`.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.title: Update a collection
tools.description: Update a collection. Collections and types of the app's records. Sets only the fields given. Fails with `not_found` if the record is deleted, trashed or hidden before the write lands, and with `conflict` if a reference field left out changes meanwhile; nothing changes then. Requires memotron:write (or nucleum). Pass `idempotencyKey` to make retries safe.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters) that makes retries safe: repeating the call with the same key and arguments does not write again and returns the record's current state. A key is remembered for 24 hours; reusing it with other arguments fails with `idempotency_key_reused`.
